events.summary: Worcester 20s & 30s November Social at NU Kitchen

description.plain:
Thursday, November 13, 2025 | 6:00 PM
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UUN000001uEfd2AE/
Join us for a social at NU Kitchen in Worcester on Thursday, November 13th at 6:00pm! Hang out with other young members and leaders from the Worcester Chapter and learn about fun upcoming trips this winter. Everyone is welcome-- new and returning participants! NU Kitchen offers a variety of salads, grain bowls, sandwiches, smoothies, and breakfast foods. Hope to see you there!Registration is required so the leader can be in touch in case of change of venue.

location.title:
Lincoln Trail, 122-198 Kearsarge Valley R
Warner, NH

description.plain:
Saturday, November 22, 2025
https://activities.outdoors.org/s/oc-activity/a5UUN000001tTTp2AM/
Join the Worcester 20s & 30s group for a hike of Mt. Kearsarge (South) in Warner, NH on Saturday, November 22nd! This hike will be just under 10 miles and around 2,500 ft elevation gain. Our intention is to go at a roughly a 1.5 mile per hour pace. Expect to be on trail for the full day.Mt. Kearsarge is part of NH's 52 with-a-view list. On a clear day, you can see the Boston skyline as well as a 360-degree view!Sturdy shoes with laces, at least 2 liters of water, snacks/lunch, and appropriate layers of clothing are required. Participants should be prepared for winter conditions and will likely be requested to bring microspikes in case of ice at higher elevations. No dogs, please. Further details, such as start time and location, will be provided to participants after they complete the required screening form, which will be sent after registering. Hope to have you join us!
